en: Vintage sepia postcard with a monochrome photograph of a sculpted bust of the Italian poet Giovanni Prati on the left, and a handwritten Italian message on the right. The bust appears rough-hewn at the base and shoulders and is captioned below. Printer's credit is vertically printed in red along the left margin of the image. The card is oriented horizontally, with the photo and caption taking the left half and the manuscript text filling the right half.
